description: Selected bundles build the agent’s environment: scripts install tools; plugins provide MCP, skills and hooks.

oomol.apiKeyHelp: Sign in to [OOMOL’s MCP configuration page](https://oomol.com/install/mcp/) to generate a key. Replace it here after resetting it in OOMOL.
oomol.teamNameHelp: Your OOMOL team, given as `x-oo-team-name` in its configuration.

descriptions.agenvo: Operate Paseo and Herdr on remote computers: workspaces, agents, input, history and terminals.
descriptions.approval: Ask the user to confirm commands blocked by rules in Eta, then allow them once approved.
descriptions.artifacts: Artifact: Publish static pages to Eta, preview them in chats and tasks, and share them publicly.
descriptions.github: Use git and gh and open PRs as Eta’s GitHub App.
descriptions.grok: Generate images and videos with Grok Imagine; search the web and X.
descriptions.groups: Group chat: Read context, invite collaboration with mentions, and organize briefs and task drafts.
descriptions.memory: Long-term memory across conversations: recall at the start of each turn and save at the end.
descriptions.oomol: OOMOL: Use oo CLI to access connected apps (email, calendars, documents and more) and hosted capabilities.
descriptions.routines: Routines: View, create and edit scheduled tasks and their reports.
descriptions.tasks: Task board: Create, assign and track tasks, including tasks executed by agents on remote computers.

pluginDescriptions.agenvo: Use agenvo to operate Paseo and Herdr on remote computers: manage workspaces and agents, send input, view history, interrupt runs and use terminals.
pluginDescriptions.approval: Ask the user to confirm commands blocked by Eta rules.
pluginDescriptions.artifacts: Publish static pages (ZIP or directory) as Artifacts to preview and share in chats and tasks.
pluginDescriptions.github: Get git and gh credentials using Eta’s GitHub App, create pull requests as the App, and draft issues for users to submit.
pluginDescriptions.grok: Use the LLM gateway’s Grok account with Grok Imagine to generate images and videos and search the web and X.
pluginDescriptions.groups: Search, collaborate and organize decisions in the current group.
pluginDescriptions.memory: Save long-term memory across conversations using the memory service.
pluginDescriptions.oomol: OOMOL’s oo CLI and its bundled skills. Credentials come from the oomol bundle configuration (OO_API_KEY, OO_TEAM_NAME).
pluginDescriptions.routines: List and view scheduled agents and their reports; create and edit routines.
pluginDescriptions.tasks: Create, assign and track tasks, including tasks executed by agents on remote computers.
